meta.title: About XePrime
meta.description: XePrime connects renters with vehicle owners across Vietnam: self-drive, with driver and long-term rentals, with prices, schedules and terms stated clearly before you book.

hero.lead:
Connecting people who need a vehicle with trusted owners across Vietnam.

Clear prices, flexible schedules and clear responsibilities before every trip.

services.title: Flexible for every rental need
services.lead: Three ways to rent for every journey, from a weekend city ride and business trips to long-term mobility for companies

selfDrive.title: Self-drive
selfDrive.desc: Drive yourself and set your own schedule. Pick up at the shop or request delivery to your door or the airport.
selfDrive.p2: Clear mileage limits, no forced packages
selfDrive.p3: Transparent checks with photos of every angle

withDriver.title: With driver
withDriver.desc: Travel in comfort and flexibility. Ideal for business trips, airport transfers, partner meetings and intercity journeys.
withDriver.p1: Route and timing agreed in advance
withDriver.p2: Fuel and parking costs as agreed

longTerm.title: Long-term rental
longTerm.desc: Flexible long-term mobility from 1 - 12 months, for individuals, families and businesses.
longTerm.p3: Simple paperwork, no large credit hold

money.title: Every fee, made clear
money.lead: Each charge is itemised, has a clear owner and is shown openly. No hidden fees, no vague costs

online.title: Online payment
online.desc: Covers the reservation fee, platform service fee and trip insurance (if added).
online.note: The reservation amount secures your trip; it is not collateral.

pickup.title: Payment at pickup
pickup.desc: The rest of the rental is paid directly between the renter and the owner when the vehicle is handed over.
pickup.note: XePrime does not touch the direct payment, so both sides keep their freedom to agree.

lines.title: Every fee, made clear
lines.desc: Platform service fee, VAT and trip insurance are shown as separate lines on the e-contract.
lines.note: Costs are fixed when the booking is confirmed, with no surcharges beyond what was agreed.

partners.title: Idle vehicle? Earn extra income
partners.lead: Two flexible partnership models on one platform, so you choose how to put your vehicle to work on your own terms.

trust.title: Safety from <accent>technology</accent> to the road
trust.lead: Trust built on verification technology, transaction protection and a strict review process.

listing.title: Vehicle checkpoints
listing.desc: Vehicle papers, registration and photos are checked by our team before they go live.

calendar.title: 1 vehicle - 1 schedule
calendar.desc: Booked slots are locked automatically, so a vehicle can never be booked twice for the same time.

metrics.title: Days of behaviour data
metrics.desc: Reputation is computed automatically from performance over the last 90 days.
